title: Quick Sauteed Australian Aubergine Bush Tucker
description: A low-carb friendly, quick-fix Australian dish featuring aubergine, sautéed with bush tucker for a sour and shaggy taste.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and swirl it around.
Add the sliced aubergine and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until it's tender and lightly browned.
Add 1 teaspoon of bush tucker and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Wash the cutting board and utensils with soap and water after use.
